customers_say: Customers find the smart lock to be of high quality, with all features working smoothly and easy to use, particularly through fingerprint recognition. They appreciate its security features, with one customer noting its secure multi-bolt system, and its versatility with multiple access methods. The installation process receives positive feedback, with one mentioning it works on both single and double panel doors. While battery life is generally good, some customers report it dying within a day.
